source_title: This 4-port UGREEN 160W GaN charger is back to its lowest price
source_excerpt:

One charger can make a big difference when your desk or travel bag is full of cables and power bricks. The UGREEN Nexode Pro 160W GaN Charger is built for that kind of setup, and it’s now down to $94.99 on Amazon, which is a 37% discount off the $149.99 RRP.
This charger is designed for people who need to power multiple devices from a single location. It has four outputs in total: a built-in retractable USB-C cable, two extra USB-C ports, and one USB-A port. That gives you room to charge a larger laptop along with smaller gear like a phone, tablet, or handheld at the same time. The retractable cable is one of the main draws here, since it helps reduce cable clutter and makes the charger easier to pack.
UGREEN also includes a smart display and touch controls, so you can check charging status and power distribution in real time. It supports modern fast-charging standards too, with high-watt USB-C charging for compatible laptops, tablets, phones, and handhelds. In short, this is the kind of charger that makes sense for someone who wants one powerful hub on a desk or in a bag instead of carrying several separate adapters.
This UGREEN 160W charger deal also brings the device back to its all-time low price on Amazon. If you’ve been waiting for a chance to grab a premium all-in-one charging option for less, this is a strong time to do it.
